# Alexander H. Wurm

Personal site of Alexander H. Wurm, Principal Analyst at Nucleus Research, where he
leads coverage of analytics and data management technologies. Background in cognitive
science and decision modeling at the University of Florida.

## Pages

- https://awurm.com/ — overview
- https://awurm.com/research/ — academic publications; industry research archive at /research/?tab=industry
- https://awurm.com/speaking/ — webinars and conference talks
- https://awurm.com/projects/ — software and research projects
- https://awurm.com/about/ — bio, experience, education, contact

## Facts

- Title: Principal Analyst, Nucleus Research (Miami, FL; Jun 2021–present; progression: Research Analyst → Senior Analyst → Principal Analyst)
- Previously: Research Assistant, UF Cognitive Modeling Laboratory (Jan 2020–May 2021)
- Education: B.A. Economics (Dean's List) and B.S. Behavioral Cognitive Neuroscience (Summa Cum Laude), University of Florida, 2017–2021
- Publication: "A model of timing in simple anticipatory decisions" — Wurm, Sokratous, Hawkins, Kvam — Proceedings of the Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society, Vol. 43 (2021) — https://escholarship.org/uc/item/2fd149qd
- Preprint: "Why am I always late? Modeling the cognitive mechanisms underlying anticipatory timing under uncertainty" — Sokratous, Hawkins, Wurm, Kvam — PsyArXiv — https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/v2gkc
